segment.affected: You live in the affected area. Your vote counts among those affected.
segment.external: You do not live in the affected area. You can vote; your vote counts as outside resonance.
segment.member: You are a member. Your vote counts.
segment.guest: Your vote counts as resonance from outside the group.

counted: Your vote is counted and secret.
closedSecret: The vote has ended. Nobody can see how you voted.
daysLeft: {n, plural, =0 {Ends today} one {1 day left} other {# days left}}
blind: Blind vote: results appear only after it ends, so nobody follows the trend.
ruleInitiative: The result of those affected is binding. Outside votes show how the issue is seen elsewhere.
ruleGoal: A goal is adopted with a majority of voting members, if at least half of the members vote.
